_meta.purpose: Bento-level dashboard patterns. A dashboard is a header row + KPI row + a GRID of self-titled panels (not stacked titled sections). `level`: 'content' = a full-width row placed directly in the work Section; 'panel' = a self-titled Card placed inside a bento-row grid cell.
_meta.spacingModel: R = md. Card padding / header→content = md; panel title↔meta = sm (R−1); tight inline pairs = xs (R−2); panels & rows to each other = lg (R+1). See dashboard/blocks.json → _meta.spacingModel.
_meta.authoringRule: Components/tokens MUST resolve against components.json / tokens.json. New panels are allowed when existing ones do not cover the need, provided they follow the spacingModel and resolve against the live registries.
_meta.placeholderConvention: <...> = fill with real content; optional trailing '?' means the node may be dropped when empty. A '<a|b|c>' placeholder is a closed choice.
_meta.refConvention: { "$ref": "block.id" } expands to that block's `plan` fragment from dashboard/blocks.json (or another pattern). The agent expands $ref when authoring the Composition Plan — the render runtime never sees $ref.

dashboard.header-row.purpose: Top of the work area: the page title (h1) + optional one-line description on the LEFT (fills), and the page's primary actions on the RIGHT (hug). A fill-left / hug-right ContainerHorizontal (NOT a spread row — a Heading does not hug). ≤1 Brand action + an optional outlined secondary. Drop the actions when there are none.

dashboard.kpi-grid.purpose: A full-width Grid of 3–6 equal stat cards — the scannable headline metrics at the top of the work area. Auto equal-height. Grid gap lg (panels to each other).

dashboard.list-panel.purpose: A self-titled panel (dashboard.panel) whose content is a row list: status rows (title+meta + status Badge/Link) OR data-breakdown rows (label+meta + value + trend Badge), separated by full-width Dividers. The dashboard table substitute. Placed in a bento-row grid cell.

dashboard.chart-panel.purpose: A self-titled panel (dashboard.panel) whose content is a chart Image at a design-system ratio. SECONDARY — place it in the NARROWER column of a bento row (e.g. the 33 side) so the image stays compact; a big 16:9 image in a wide card reads like content-page media. When a compact view matters, use dashboard.list-panel (data breakdown) instead — the image system has no flat sparkline ratio.

dashboard.bento-row.purpose: One row of the bento: a Grid split into 2–3 columns holding self-titled panels side by side. Pick the split by panel importance — 66-33 / 33-66 pairs a wide primary panel with a narrow secondary (put a chart in the 33 side); 50-50 for equal peers; (Def) 33-33-33 for three equal peers. Grid gap lg. The runtime auto-equalizes panel heights across the row.

dashboard.data-toolbar.purpose: A full-width control row for the data region below it: a leading search Input (fills), an optional scope Select, a view-switch (interactive-toggle Tags — the DB-native segmented control in place of the missing Tabs component) and a trailing primary action. Floating-label fields so heights match the button/tags. Sits directly above a table-panel or list-panel (its lead), never on its own.

dashboard.table-panel.purpose: A self-titled panel (dashboard.panel) whose content is a COLUMN-ALIGNED table: a header-label Grid (bold muted Body Small, numeric columns right-aligned) + a Divider, then data rows — each a Grid using the SAME gridLayout so cells line up into columns — separated by Dividers. The DB-native table (there is no Table component); use it instead of faking a table from frames. An optional dashboard.toolbar can lead the panel for search/scope/view controls. Keep to ≤6 columns; wrap in a bento cell wide enough to avoid cramped columns (a table-panel usually takes the full row or the wide side of a 66-33 split).

dashboard.tab-panel.purpose: A bento panel that switches between 2–4 related views inside one card using the real DB Tabs (Beta) — the section switcher lives in the tab strip; the active Tab Panel holds a list / chart / breakdown. Use for a single area with a few equally-weighted views; prefer a Tag toolbar (dashboard.toolbar) for a tighter 2-way switch, and Tabs when the views are distinct enough to name.

dashboard.goal-card.purpose: A KPI card for a metric with a target/completion: Label + big Value + a linear ProgressBar + target caption (DB LoadingIndicator BAR Progress, Concept). Sits in the KPI row or a bento cell like a stat-card. Pick the bar's Value stop (25/50/75%) nearest the real percentage and match the Value text to it.
